independent_review.text:
# Independent review: eight select/autocomplete source decisions

Supports the bounded main-line source decisions in patch `715ff6145e5c2cfde845d5e99ca21b4f5b666066943f21c8df3f21404bf5993a` against base `ab3d9da89c9e2f5d27a4d530bc2a3412603f1ef5`. The patch strictly applies in a private index, producing tree `2bd8daad782f918eb0fe6ad1a96ee97eea86c0ce`. All 1,697 ledger rows retain their order; exactly the eight named records change, with all other rows and ledger metadata unchanged. Every complete predecessor ledger record matches base. The first five records additionally preserve the complete V2 proposed row and complete per-SHA predecessor review; their tagged-16 inheritance correction remains intact. All eight full parent-diff bytes independently match the cached upstream Git objects, and all declared candidate source-member hashes match the fixture and current physical f522 tree at review time. Current f522 retains all eight exact predecessor ledger rows; integration must still recheck the moving tree and merge by SHA.

The five previously reviewed source decisions remain bounded: requireSelection pre-keydown capture, shared-panel latest-trigger tracking, owned form-field connected-origin exclusions, local shadow-piercing focus lookup, and legacy enabled select cursor. The pointer change can alter physical hit targets without changing those source predicates, and the new records say so. Tagged-16 wrappers inherit their shared autocomplete bases. All seven embedded tagged source snapshots were independently decoded and byte-compared to commit `df60e733c60e572ba538f6ad0ceff3e63e527b53`.

The three additional decisions are supported as follows:

* `979e9030`: the full upstream diff changes one modern hidden-panel CSS declaration. The owned trigger instead controls its attached legacy OverlayRef pane with guarded inline pointer-state restoration; the current role matches the independently reviewed finite packed physical-click repair. The same-value inline-write ambiguity and consumer overrides remain explicit.
* `12b76711`: the full upstream diff switches the modern render-hook injector to EnvironmentInjector. The owned helper retains its view injector, zone-stability/render race, explicit teardown and manual-injector fallback. The minimum Angular 22.1.7 declaration accepts `Injector` for `AfterRenderOptions.injector`; that type check does not prove all custom injector or view lifetime behavior.
* `249db698`: the full upstream diff replaces zone-stability initial waiting, introduces initialized-subject handling, moves the closing-action subscription zone boundary, and changes extensive timing tests. The owned initialized subject and hybrid helper are source-specific; closing actions remain outside the zone-run reset callback. The decision deliberately retains that ordering, without claiming general timing equivalence.

The independently replayed unchanged production dispatcher on an isolated eight-row seed reports no insufficient individual rows or missing evidence, while overall admission is incomplete with exit 1 because the full authored-use inventories are absent. Separate controls in this directory reproduce rejection of actual source drift, changed upstream diff, forged source hash, wrong branch and an unsupported execution claim. A coherent false human decision with matching metadata is accepted as individual evidence: the checker binds identities and structural consistency, not semantic truth. The seven tagged snapshots and full-diff comparison above are therefore human-review evidence, not an automatic semantic guarantee.

No new packed/runtime, full-ledger admission, G11, security or release qualification is asserted. The retained d24d pointer/browser and protocol replay results are bounded supporting evidence, not execution claims by the eight source records.
